source: hand-computed from the M_PDU header layout
note: The 2-octet M_PDU header that opens a multiplexing-service data field. The First Header Pointer has two special values at the top of its range, so both are pinned.

encode.name: mpdu-header-no-packet-start
encode.note: The M_PDU First Header Pointer is 11 bits and 0x7ff means no packet starts in this frame. Packed big-endian into the 2-octet M_PDU header: byte 0 = (0x7ff>>8)&0x07 = 0x07, byte 1 = 0x7ff&0xff = 0xff, followed by the packet zone 0xaa.

encode.name: mpdu-header-all-idle
encode.note: 0x7fe, one below all-ones, means the packet zone holds only idle data. byte 0 = (0x7fe>>8)&0x07 = 0x07, byte 1 = 0x7fe&0xff = 0xfe, followed by the packet zone 0xaa.
